entities.summary: Minnamari "Minttu" Tuominen is a Finnish retired ice hockey player and the strength and conditioning coach of Kiekko-Espoo in the Auroraliiga. A member of the Finnish national ice hockey team from 2008 until 2022, she earned medals at three Winter Olympic Games and five IIHF Women's World Championships.
